name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx web serving for three virtual hosts, including site configuration, document roots, HTTPS certificate paths, development certificates, and related host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, runtime directories, logging, and service configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
